review_note: Retain the governing sentence, legacy-system satire, mixed classroom and concrete overview. Cut declarations of sincerity and align the journal loop with its stated week-2 start.

edits.before:
It is a systems course, and it is sincere. Every week ends with scripts you
    can say, timings you can check, and lines you can test yourself against.
edits.after:
Every week ends with scripts you can say, timings you can check, and lines
    you can test yourself against.
edits.reason: The scripts and checks demonstrate the teaching purpose without a claim of sincerity.

edits.before:
Every week runs the same loop. A lecture writes a part of the protocol down,
    a lab tests that writing in the room, and a journal entry checks it against
    a real exchange of your own — which is where the next week starts.
edits.after:
A lecture writes a part of the protocol down, and a lab tests that writing
    in the room. From week 2, a weekly journal entry checks it against a real
    exchange of your own.
edits.reason: Make the existing week-2 journal start explicit and avoid promising that every next lecture begins with each student’s findings.

edits.before: caption="The week, which runs eleven times. The journal entry is the edge back: what you tested on Sunday is what the next lecture is arguing with."
edits.after: caption="From week 2: lecture, lab and journal. An observation can send you back to revise the rule."
edits.reason: Describe the loop without repeating the paragraph or scripting the next lecture’s reaction.

edits.before:
Not on the list, on purpose: becoming indistinguishable from anybody. The
    outcome is fluency plus choice.
edits.after:
The outcome is fluency plus choice, without having to become
    indistinguishable from anybody.
edits.reason: Preserve the essential aim while removing the announcement that the omission was deliberate.

edits.before: {readingCount} sources, each checked against the source itself.
edits.after: {readingCount} sources, with notes on what was checked.
edits.reason: The entries distinguish full-text, abstract and other checks; the card should point readers to that record rather than flatten those limits.
